# Mintek Software

> Custom software, automation and websites for growing businesses

Mintek Software builds custom software, business automation and high-performing websites that streamline operations and support business growth. Based in Brampton and serving businesses across Toronto, Mississauga, Vaughan and the Greater Toronto Area. In-person meetings are available.

## Services

- [All Services](https://minteksoftware.com/services): Overview of everything Mintek Software builds.
- [Custom Software Development](https://minteksoftware.com/custom-software-development): Tailored applications, dashboards and internal tools built around your exact workflows.
- [Business Automation](https://minteksoftware.com/business-automation): Automate repetitive manual work so your team can focus on what matters.
- [Web Application Development](https://minteksoftware.com/web-application-development): Fast, data-driven web apps, portals and dashboards that run in any browser.
- [Website Development](https://minteksoftware.com/website-development): Fast, responsive, SEO-ready websites that turn visitors into customers.
- [Marketplace Development](https://minteksoftware.com/marketplace-development): Two-sided and location-based marketplaces with listings, search and maps.
- [Google Sheets Website Development](https://minteksoftware.com/google-sheets-website-development): Websites and web apps your team updates through a familiar spreadsheet.
- [Spreadsheet Automation](https://minteksoftware.com/spreadsheet-automation): Turn manual spreadsheet work into automated reporting, syncing and dashboards.
- [Mobile App Development](https://minteksoftware.com/mobile-app-development): Cross-platform mobile apps that deliver a great experience on iOS and Android.
- [Custom Software Development Toronto](https://minteksoftware.com/custom-software-development-toronto): Custom applications and internal tools for Toronto and GTA businesses.
- [Business Automation Toronto](https://minteksoftware.com/business-automation-toronto): Automate manual workflows for Toronto and GTA businesses.
- [Web Design Brampton](https://minteksoftware.com/web-design-brampton): Mintek is a Brampton software company that builds business websites. The work covers how the site looks, how it performs, how it gets found, and what happens when you need it to do more later.
- [Small Business Website Design Brampton](https://minteksoftware.com/small-business-website-design-brampton): Focused first websites for Brampton small businesses — built to convert local searches, not to look like a template.
- [Web Design Services Brampton](https://minteksoftware.com/web-design-services-brampton): The specific web design jobs we do for Brampton businesses — not a vague “full service” menu.
- [Website Hosting Brampton](https://minteksoftware.com/website-hosting-brampton): How we host and launch Brampton business websites — deployment, HTTPS and accounts you control.
- [Restaurant Website Design](https://minteksoftware.com/restaurant-website-design): Menu-first, mobile-friendly websites that turn diners into calls and visits.
- [Web Design Toronto](https://minteksoftware.com/web-design-toronto): Fast, conversion-focused websites for Toronto businesses.
- [Local SEO Services (GTA)](https://minteksoftware.com/local-seo-gta): SEO audits, on-page, technical and local SEO for GTA and Toronto businesses.

## Case Studies

- [Case Studies](https://minteksoftware.com/case-studies): Selected projects and outcomes.
- [Building a Map-First Parking Marketplace for Canadian Cities](https://minteksoftware.com/case-studies/parking-marketplace-platform): A map-first parking marketplace with location search, listings and geographic filtering, built with React, TypeScript, Node and Mapbox.
- [Building a Google Sheets-Powered Event Discovery Web App](https://minteksoftware.com/case-studies/google-sheets-event-discovery-app): A read-only event-discovery web app powered by Google Sheets, with registration handled externally on Eventbrite.
- [Website and AI Blog Engine for a Brampton CPA Firm](https://minteksoftware.com/case-studies/aloe-accounting): A fast, SEO-first website for a licensed Brampton CPA firm, with an AI-assisted weekly blog pipeline and a review-management dashboard.
- [Restaurant Online Ordering System](https://minteksoftware.com/case-studies/restaurant-online-ordering-system): A fully custom online ordering system with integrated payments, real-time order management, and SMS marketing.
- [Creating a Brampton Dog Daycare Website and Waitlist Funnel](https://minteksoftware.com/case-studies/pawpals): A Brampton dog daycare website with a waitlist funnel built to convert local, mobile visitors into enquiries.
- [Restaurant Website Design for Doaba Junction](https://minteksoftware.com/case-studies/doaba-junction): A mobile-first restaurant website focused on menu presentation, calls, directions and catering enquiries.
- [Cafe Website Design for an Australian Hospitality Business](https://minteksoftware.com/case-studies/relax-cafe): A mobile-first cafe website for an Australian hospitality business, demonstrating international client delivery.
- [Building a Calendly-Style Booking Platform for Service Providers](https://minteksoftware.com/case-studies/bookme-scheduling-platform): A Calendly-style, multi-staff booking platform with a timezone-correct availability engine, Google Calendar sync and automated reminders, built on the MERN stack with TypeScript.

## Guides

- [Blog](https://minteksoftware.com/blog): Practical guides for GTA businesses on software, automation and websites.
- [How Much Does a Business Website Cost in the GTA?](https://minteksoftware.com/blog/how-much-does-a-business-website-cost-in-the-gta): A clear, no-nonsense guide to business website costs in the Greater Toronto Area: typical price ranges, what drives the price up or down, and how to budget with confidence.
- [Custom Web Development in Brampton: What It Actually Means (and When You Need It)](https://minteksoftware.com/blog/custom-web-development-brampton): Custom web development in Brampton: how it differs from a template site, when a small business needs it, and what Mintek's published starting prices cover.
- [Do Brampton Business Websites Actually Have Contact Forms?](https://minteksoftware.com/blog/do-brampton-business-websites-actually-have-contact-forms): Among 87 fetched Brampton homepages, a form element appeared on 47 (54.0%). What that tag measures — and why it is not a working contact form.
- [How Many Brampton Business Websites Make It Easy to Call?](https://minteksoftware.com/blog/how-many-brampton-business-websites-make-it-easy-to-call): Among 87 fetched Brampton homepages, a click-to-call tel: link was on 58 (66.7%). What that measures — and why a visible number is not the same thing.
- [LocalBusiness Schema: How Many Brampton Websites Actually Use It?](https://minteksoftware.com/blog/localbusiness-schema-brampton-websites): Among 87 fetched Brampton homepages, JSON-LD was detected on 62.1%; LocalBusiness-style types on 41.4%. What that measurement is — and is not.
- [How Much Does a Brampton Business Website Actually Need to Load?](https://minteksoftware.com/blog/how-much-does-a-brampton-business-website-need-to-load): Brampton homepages median 3.3 MB and 86 requests. What page weight costs, when video and widgets earn their keep, and why every homepage element has a cost.
